accessibility_and_performance.target: WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented implementation, with manual verification; do not claim compliance based only on screenshots.
required: All interactive functions usable by keyboard and touch.
Visible focus indicators and clear semantic labels.
Navigation expanded state synchronized with visual state.
No horizontal overflow at supported mobile widths.
Generous touch targets around 44px as a design target, with sufficient spacing.
Normal text contrast at least 4.5:1; large text at least 3:1.
Do not use current white #FFFFFF on orange #FF6B35 for button text; observed ratio is approximately 2.84:1.
Use suitable dark text on existing orange or adjust orange for white text; test default, hover, and focus states.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a static hero fallback.
Provide pause/stop for continuing automatic hero motion; hover-only pause is insufficient.
No critical information available only on hover.
Hover/focus supplemental content must be dismissible, reachable, and persistent while used.
Reserve image/video dimensions to avoid layout movement.
Load meaningful text and first poster image promptly; video is an enhancement.
Suspend background animation when offscreen or the tab is hidden.
Validate poster cropping and contrast throughout all video frames.

field_performance_targets.note: Targets, not measured current performance. Lab testing alone cannot establish field INP or a population-level pass.

motion_asset.status: Static PNG exists; no MP4 has been created.
motion_asset.direction: Camera and hardware remain fixed. Cyan pulses travel slowly along existing filaments, with restrained repeating illumination on the glass edges. Preserve the dark left text area.

output_targets.loop: Seamless over consecutive repetitions; avoid jumps or exposure changes

motion_asset.preferred_creation: After Effects overlays: retain PNG base, trace selected filament paths, animate glowing strokes, mask occlusion, animate glass-edge illumination, synchronize repeating cycles.

alternatives.tradeoff: Faster prompting workflow, but inspect for camera drift, changed geometry, and imperfect looping.
Free manual compositing alternative with a more technical interface.
Full 3D reconstruction only if justified; unnecessary for the fixed-camera overlay approach.
Optional MP4 compression and web-optimized fast start.

motion_asset.ai_motion_prompt: Locked-off camera. The hardware module and three glass layers remain perfectly stationary and retain their exact shapes. Small cyan light pulses travel slowly along the existing curved filaments, following their paths around the module. The glass edges gently brighten and dim in a subtle repeating rhythm. The dark left half remains completely still and unchanged. Restrained, elegant motion with consistent exposure and lighting. Continuous shot designed for a seamless loop.
motion_asset.workflow_constraint: Do not buy tools, install plugins, or spend video-generation credits merely because they appear in this brief. Use available authorized capabilities or retain the static fallback.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Homepage statistics strip removed and replaced by four clear guided starts.
All four offers understandable, with working direct service and contact routes.
Each checker has a dedicated route, focused dynamic steps, and immediate useful results.
Browser and in-tool navigation preserve answers; refresh restores session progress.
Upstream answer changes clear invalid dependent answers and recalculate results.
Unknown and exceptional cases are explained without false certainty or fake compliance scores.
Production outcomes are grounded in reviewed, versioned rules with current source references.
No contact gate before results; any follow-up carries relevant prior answers without re-entry.
No invented Continuum features, official affiliations, accreditations, customer claims, or testimonials.
Hero text/actions stationary; mobile text precedes artwork; controls hidden for one slide.
Any continuous motion has pause and reduced-motion fallback; optional media failure leaves the page usable.
Keyboard/touch flows work; focus moves correctly; menus expose accurate expanded state.
No unintended horizontal scrolling at 320px, 390px, 768px, and representative desktop widths; zoom/reflow checked.
Text and controls meet applicable contrast requirements in all states.
No dead CTAs, fake downloads, or silent form submissions; public data handling matches actual implementation.
Existing useful links remain valid or receive deliberate redirects; no unnecessary framework migration.
Appropriate repository checks pass and changed journeys are visually verified; report limitations accurately.
Performance measured and documented against stated targets; no unmeasured performance or conversion claims.
